# Ibrahim Hussein — Complete Professional Profile

> Computer Engineer & AI Developer | Kurdistan Region, Iraq | Salahaddin University-Erbil

## Professional Summary

Ibrahim Hussein is an award-winning Computer Engineering student at Salahaddin University-Erbil, Kurdistan Region, Iraq. He specializes in artificial intelligence, full-stack web development, and embedded systems. As co-founder of CSAI (Customer Service AI), he showcased the platform at HITEX Technology Expo 2025. He builds production-grade applications serving real businesses across Kurdistan and Iraq.

## Projects Portfolio

### 1. Chat Mart — Omni-Channel SaaS (2025)
**Type**: Production SaaS Platform
**URL**: https://chat-mart.com
**Description**: Evolution of CSAI into a full multi-company marketplace with 5 messaging channels (WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Viber, Messenger), Kurdish TTS voice replies, RBAC with 17+ permissions, reservation system, and PWA.
**Impact**: Deployed at chat-mart.com serving multiple companies with AI-powered customer service across 5 channels in 3 languages.
**Tech**: PHP, MySQL, WhatsApp API, Instagram API, Telegram Bot API, PWA, Kurdish NLP

### 2. CSAI — Customer Service AI (2024-2025)
**Type**: AI Chatbot Platform
**Description**: AI-powered customer service chatbot that understands Kurdish (Sorani & Kurmanji), Arabic, and English. Multi-dialect NLP, real-time responses, multi-provider WhatsApp integration. Showcased at HITEX Technology Expo 2025.
**Impact**: First production Kurdish AI customer service platform. Demonstrated at Iraq's largest technology expo.
**Tech**: PHP, MySQL, OpenAI API, WhatsApp Cloud API, Kurdish NLP

### 3. Ashti Library (2024)
**Type**: E-Commerce Platform
**URL**: https://ashtilibrary.com
**Description**: Complete Kurdish bookstore website with search/filtering, admin dashboard, AI chatbot using Google Gemini API for book recommendations, full RTL Kurdish support, and WhatsApp ordering integration.
**Impact**: First production Kurdish bookstore platform with AI recommendations.
**Tech**: Web, AI, Gemini API, RTL, WhatsApp Integration

### 4. True Prence — Face Recognition Attendance (2024)
**Type**: AI/Computer Vision
**GitHub**: https://github.com/ibrahim-ibo-dev/Attendance-System
**Description**: Face recognition attendance system identifying up to 20 students per frame simultaneously. Supports CNN (GPU) or HOG (CPU) detection, SQLite storage, Tkinter UI, Excel/PDF/chart exports.
**Impact**: Enables passive, zero-interaction attendance for full classrooms.
**Tech**: Python, OpenCV, face_recognition, dlib, CUDA, SQLite, Tkinter

### 5. Signed Language Recognition (2024)
**Type**: AI/Accessibility
**GitHub**: https://github.com/ibrahim-ibo-dev/AI-Sign-Language
**Description**: Real-time gesture recognition using MediaPipe hand/body tracking combined with a custom-trained KNN classifier. Features incremental learning, 3x data augmentation, and temporal dynamics analysis. Built for ~250,000 people in Kurdistan with hearing/speech difficulties.
**Impact**: Demonstrates sign language recognition with zero specialized hardware, using only a laptop camera.
**Tech**: Python, MediaPipe, scikit-learn, KNN, NumPy

### 6. Bradaran & Dyari — Car Dealership Systems (2024-2025)
**Type**: Business Management Platform
**Description**: Full car dealership management systems with inventory tracking, customer management, sales pipeline, RBAC with 17+ permissions, dual-database architecture, installment tracking, PWA with push notifications, and full RTL Kurdish interface.
**Impact**: Deployed for real clients managing full dealership operations digitally.
**Tech**: PHP, MySQL, PDO, PWA, Push Notifications, RBAC

### 7. Home System — Smart IoT (2024)
**Type**: Hardware/IoT
**Description**: Smart home system presented at NICER Club, Lebanese French University. Features environmental monitoring, automated control, and remote access via custom web dashboard.
**Impact**: Earned certificate from NICER Club, recognition from university heads.
**Tech**: Arduino, ESP32, Sensors, Web Dashboard
